summary_en: Inabata authorized acquisition of up to 1.00 million shares (1.86% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥5.4 billion via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 10, 2026 and March 31, 2027, with acquired shares to be cancelled.
title_en: Notice regarding Decision of Matters concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Inabata & Co., Ltd. resolved to acquire its own shares on November 5, 2026. The acquisition program authorizes the purchase of up to 1,000,000 shares (1.86% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥5.4 billion. Purchases will be conducted via market transactions using a trust arrangement method on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the acquisition period running from November 10, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The fixed unit purchase price was not disclosed in this announcement.

The company stated that the share buyback aligns with its three-year Medium-Term Business Plan "New Challenge 2026" (final fiscal year ending March 2027), which identifies "further enhancement of capital efficiency and emphasis on shareholder returns" as a critical financial strategy. All acquired treasury shares are intended to be cancelled, with the specific number to be announced following completion of the acquisition program.
